seo-description: Privacy policy for lucrousseau.com. Learn how we handle your data, analytics, and contact information when you visit or interact with Luc Rousseau's website.
title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we handle your information
intro: This privacy policy explains how lucrousseau.com collects, uses, and protects information when you visit the site or contact Luc Rousseau for professional services.
data:
Analytics. This site uses Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to collect anonymous usage data: page views, geographic region (country/city level), referrer, device type, and performance metrics. No personally identifiable information is collected through analytics. This data helps improve site performance and content relevance.

Contact information. When you email or schedule a consultation, we collect your name, email address, and any information you provide in your message. This information is used solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential professional services. Contact information is stored securely and never shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

No cookies for tracking. This site does not use cookies for advertising or cross-site tracking. Analytics are collected without cookies using server-side measurement.
usage:
Information collected is used exclusively for the following purposes: improving website performance and user experience through anonymous analytics; responding to professional inquiries and scheduling consultations; maintaining communication during active consulting engagements; and legal compliance when required.

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for their marketing purposes. Contact information is stored in secure email systems and scheduling platforms (Calendly) that comply with industry-standard security practices.
security:
This website implements security measures including HTTPS encryption for all traffic, Content Security Policy headers to prevent cross-site scripting and injection attacks, secure authentication for API endpoints, and regular security audits of dependencies and infrastructure.

Contact information shared via email or scheduling platforms is protected by those services' security measures. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of Calendly and your email provider for details on their data handling practices.
retention: Analytics data is retained according to Vercel's data retention policy, typically 90 days for detailed metrics. Contact information from professional inquiries is retained for the duration of our business relationship and may be kept longer for legal or legitimate business purposes. You may request deletion of your contact information at any time by emailing hello@lucrousseau.com.
rights:
You have the right to: access the personal information we hold about you; request correction of inaccurate information; request deletion of your contact information; opt out of future communications; and withdraw consent for data processing at any time.

To exercise any of these rights, contact hello@lucrousseau.com. We will respond to requests within 30 days.
third-party: This site uses the following third-party services: Vercel for hosting and analytics, Calendly for scheduling consultations, and Email providers for communication. Each service has its own privacy policy governing how they handle data. We recommend reviewing their policies if you have concerns about how your information is processed.
changes: This privacy policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Material changes will be noted with an updated effective date. Continued use of the site after changes indicates acceptance of the updated policy.
contact: If you have questions about this privacy policy or how your information is handled, contact Luc Rousseau at hello@lucrousseau.com.
location: Luc Rousseau operates from Quebec, Canada.
